consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1966-11-29 show at The Matrix features a unique and energetic performance from the Grateful Dead, showcasing early versions of several songs. Despite some concerns about the recording quality and the accuracy of the setlist, the overall vibe and historical significance of the show resonate positively with many listeners.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 24 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the performance and historical context, concerns about the recording quality and inaccuracies in the setlist led to a more tempered overall sentiment.
